function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a common encoder frame. If the requested interface is supported, it returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface of the object

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv will contain NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the method succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code. Specifically, if ppv is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the requested interface is not supported, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the CommonEncoderFrame object and returns the updated reference count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface of the CommonEncoderFrame object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the CommonEncoderFrame object.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_Release
function.description: This function releases the CommonEncoderFrame object and decrements its reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, it releases the associated IWICBitmapEncoder object and frees the memory allocated to the CommonEncoderFrame object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface of the CommonEncoderFrame object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the CommonEncoderFrame object after it has been decremented.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes the common encoder frame. It reads the encoder options from the property bag, sets the interlace and filter options, and then locks the parent object to set the encoder frame and initialization status.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapFrameEncode *iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the bitmap frame that is to be encoded.

parameters.name: IPropertyBag2 *pIEncoderOptions
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the property bag that contains the encoder options.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. If the function executes successfully, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetSize
function.description: This function sets the size of a common encoder frame. It checks if the width and height are valid for ICNS icon generation, and if the frame is initialized and not created yet, it sets the width and height of the encoder frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap frame encode

parameters.name: uiWidth
parameters.description: The width of the frame

parameters.name: uiHeight
parameters.description: The height of the frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the width and height are not valid for ICNS icon generation, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized or already created.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetResolution
function.description: This function sets the resolution of a common encoder frame. It first checks if the frame is initialized and not created. If these conditions are met, it sets the dpiX and dpiY values of the encoder frame and returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap frame encode

parameters.name: dpiX
parameters.description: The horizontal resolution to set for the encoder frame

parameters.name: dpiY
parameters.description: The vertical resolution to set for the encoder frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetPixelFormat
function.description: This function sets the pixel format for a common encoder frame. It checks if the frame is initialized and not created, gets the supported format from the encoder, and if successful, sets the pixel format, bits per pixel, and indexed values for the encoder frame.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapFrameEncode *iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the bitmap frame that needs to be encoded.

parameters.name: WICPixelFormatGUID *pPixelFormat
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the pixel format GUID that needs to be set for the encoder frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized or already created, otherwise it returns the result of getting the supported format from the encoder.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetColorContexts

parameters.name: iface

parameters.name: cCount

parameters.name: ppIColorContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the color context

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, in this case it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetPalette
function.description: This function sets the palette for a common encoder frame. It checks if the palette and the frame are initialized and created, respectively. If not, it returns an error. If they are, it gets the colors from the palette and assigns them to the encoder frame's palette.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to a bitmap frame encoder.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: This is the palette to be set to the encoder frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success or an error code.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_SetThumbnail
function.description: This function is a stub and currently does not perform any operation. It is intended to set the thumbnail for a common encoder frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to a bitmap frame encode object.

parameters.name: pIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the thumbnail bitmap source.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. Currently, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_WritePixels
function.description: This function writes pixel data to an encoder frame. It checks if the frame is initialized and has valid dimensions. If the frame is not created yet, it creates one. Then it writes the lines to the encoder. It also manages thread safety using critical sections.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for a bitmap frame encoder.

parameters.name: lineCount
parameters.description: The number of lines to write.

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: The stride, or width in memory, of the lines to write.

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: The size of the buffer that contains the pixel data.

parameters.name: pbPixels
parameters.description: Pointer to the pixel data to write.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized or has invalid dimensions, E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are invalid, or the error code from the encoder_write_lines function.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_WriteSource
function.description: This function writes the source of a common encoder frame. It first checks if the frame is initialized. If not, it returns an error. If it is initialized, it configures the write source and writes the source.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the bitmap frame encode

parameters.name: pIBitmapSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap source

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle area of the bitmap source

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the frame is not initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE. If there is an error during the operation, it returns the corresponding error code.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_Commit
function.description: This function commits the frame for the common encoder. It checks if the frame is created and if the lines written are equal to the height of the encoder frame. If not, it returns an error. If yes, it commits the frame to the encoder and updates the status of the frame and the uncommitted frame in the parent encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap frame that needs to be encoded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the frame is not created or the lines written are not equal to the height of the encoder frame or the frame is already committed, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE.

function.name: CommonEncoderFrame_GetMetadataQueryWriter
function.description: This function retrieves a metadata query writer from a common encoder frame.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapFrameEncode *iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to a bitmap frame encoder.

parameters.name: IWICMetadataQueryWriter **ppIMetadataQueryWriter
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a metadata query writer. The function fills this with the requested metadata query writer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a type used in Windows programming to represent error or success codes. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the ppIMetadataQueryWriter parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the encoder is not initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED. If the encoder does not support metadata, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION.

function.name: CommonEncoder_CreateNewFrame
function.description: This function creates a new frame for a common encoder. It initializes the frame, sets up the encoder options, and manages the encoder's state.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapEncoder interface that represents the encoder.

parameters.name: ppIFrameEncode
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface that will receive the new frame.

parameters.name: ppIEncoderOptions
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IPropertyBag2 interface that will receive the encoder options.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION if the encoder does not support multiple frames, WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the encoder is not initialized, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: CommonEncoder_Commit
function.description: This function commits the encoder if it is not already committed or if there is no uncommitted frame. It locks the encoder during the operation to prevent other threads from accessing it simultaneously.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an interface of a Windows Imaging Component (WIC) bitmap encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the encoder is already committed or if there is an uncommitted frame. Otherwise, it returns the result of the encoder_commit_file function.

function.name: CommonEncoder_CreateInstance

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: Pointer to an encoder structure that the function will use to create a CommonEncoder instance

parameters.name: encoder_info

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface Identifier (IID) that the function will use to query an interface on the created CommonEncoder instance

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer where the function will store the queried interface if successful

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if the instance creation fails, otherwise it returns the result of the interface query operation
